name: Scary Baboon With-Staff
summary: Scary Baboon With-Staff.  is a horror VR game with many things to do. Play with your friends, explore the map, mess around with different staff items, and run from monsters. Explore different areas, find things around the map, and see what happens while you're playing. There are plenty of things to mess around with, whether you're playing with friends or just exploring on your own. Watch out for the monsters and try not to get caught.
